description_en: Queries device brand information by brand ID or brand name
description_zh: 根据品牌ID或品牌名称，查询获取设备品牌信息
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc describe-device-brand --project-id projectTest --device-brand-id 1 --device-brand TmallGenius --start 0 --length 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDeviceBrand

parameters.help_en: The device brand ID to query. This parameter and **DeviceBrand** cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh: 查询的设备品牌ID，和**DeviceBrand**不能同时为空
parameters.name: device_brand_id

parameters.help_en: The device brand name to query. This parameter and **DeviceBrandId** cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh: 查询的设备品牌名称，和**DeviceBrandId**不能同时为空
parameters.name: device_brand

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query list
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The maximum length of the query list
parameters.name: length
